_meta.pack: Fantasy RPG Tileset Pack (Time Fantasy style)
_meta.license: Commercial pixel pack (purchased). Direct in-game use OK; NO AI input. (Time Fantasy style.)
_meta.note: GRID VERIFIED 2026-08-07 (grid drawn over the PNG at 9-26x - lines land exactly on tile edges; 816x464 / 16 = 51x29 = 1479 frames, no remainder). Time Fantasy dungeon tileset (finalbossblues, 2017). The pack writes its own section headings INTO the sheet: AUTOTILES at c1,r5 and CEILING at c2,r21 - both are named as regions so they are not mistaken for art. ROW-BAND TRIAGE: rows 1-4 dirt and stone floor variants, rocks/plants/mushrooms, a trap-spike section, plus desert-structure and castle-wall sections on the right; rows 6-18 the autotile strips (see caveat) alongside desert pathway walls, castle interiors, statues, props and stairs; rows 22-27 CEILING borders in six colours (brown, tan, white, teal-blue, stone, dark-grey); cols 27-33 dungeon props - signs, crates, barrels, jars, mine tracks, railings, crystal clusters, boulders and rubble pits. CAVEAT - THE AUTOTILE STRIPS ARE NOT YET USABLE AS TERRAIN: rows 6-18 cols 1-16 are 16-wide strips, one material per row, but the FRAME ORDERING within a strip is undetermined. Pixel-sampling the edges produced duplicates and gaps, and the pack's own guide.png documents hand-placing edge tiles (A-F callouts) rather than any bitmask order. They are named as regions (inventory) only. Deriving the order is a prerequisite for turning them into autotile terrains, and would need a 16-slot extension to autotile.js, whose format is 9 slots.
